items.implication: WR1/2 upside.

items.text: Seahawks place rookie RB Jadarian Price on IR (chest); misses minimum four weeks.
items.implication: Walker/others handle backfield.

items.text: Colts WR Keenan Allen downgraded to OUT (groin) for London game vs Commanders; Nick Westbrook-Ikhine elevated.
items.implication: Targets to Downs/Pittman/Pierce.

items.text: Eagles situation worse: without DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun vs Rams.
items.implication: Rams offense boosted; PHI pass catchers limited.

items.text: Jordan Addison truthers moment: home vs borderline secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.implication: WR2/flex smash potential.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return; Cowboys DvP inflates opposing WR by 7.3% (most in NFL), Texans high implied total.
items.implication: WR1 upside smash.

items.text: Loves Jaylen Warren (@ CLE): 90% snaps, 20/22 touches last week, CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game; full workhorse with Dowdle out.
items.implication: RB1/2 start.

items.text: Loves Jeremiyah Love (@ NYG): RB5 utilization, 26 touches, NYG allows 5.1 YPC; double-digit target share every game.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex.

items.text: Loves Drake London (@ NO): 35%+ TS career w/ Penix, 43.5% last week (9-194); NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.implication: WR1 lock.

items.text: Hates Omarion Hampton (@ SEA): low utilization (3.5% TS, 25% routes, 42% snaps), SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
items.implication: Sit/avoid.
